subject: science
title: REVIEW FINAL TEST 1 - TỔNG ÔN KHOA HỌC HỌC KÌ 1
subTitle: Units 2 & 3: Sound & Pitch, Matter & Particles, Atmosphere & Properties of Water

cards.vietnamese: Âm thanh được tạo ra bởi sự rung động (vibrations)
cards.definition: Sound is produced when an object vibrates back and forth rapidly.
cards.example: Plucking a guitar string makes it vibrate and produce sound waves.

cards.vietnamese: Âm lượng (to hay nhỏ, tính bằng dB) vs Cao độ (trầm hay bổng)
cards.definition: Volume = loudness (dB); Pitch = how high or low a musical sound is.
cards.example: A whisper is quiet (20 dB); a bird chirp is high-pitched, thunder is low-pitched.

cards.vietnamese: Đơn vị Decibel (dB) & Ngưỡng nguy hiểm cho tai (>85 dB)
cards.definition: Unit: Decibels (dB). Sounds above 85 dB cause permanent hearing damage.
cards.example: Conversation ≈ 60 dB, Lawnmower ≈ 100 dB, Aeroplane takeoff ≈ 120 dB.

cards.vietnamese: Vật ngắn hơn, mỏng hơn, căng hơn -> Rung nhanh hơn -> Cao độ cao hơn (Higher pitch)
cards.definition: Shorter, thinner, tighter = FASTER vibrations = HIGHER pitch.
cards.example: Longer, thicker, looser = SLOWER vibrations = LOWER pitch.

cards.vietnamese: Giảm thanh, tiêu âm (muffle): vật liệu mềm, xốp (len, xốp, mút) hấp thụ rung động
cards.definition: Soft and porous materials absorb vibrations and make sounds quieter.
cards.example: Car engines use silencers. Blankets and wool muffle the ticking of a clock.

cards.vietnamese: Microphone (thu sóng âm) -> Amplifier (khuếch đại) -> Loudspeaker (phát âm to)
cards.definition: Microphone catches sound -> Amplifier boosts electrical signal -> Loudspeaker emits sound.
cards.example: Singers use a microphone and amplifier in a large auditorium.

cards.vietnamese: Chất rắn (khít, rung tại chỗ) | Chất lỏng (trượt qua nhau) | Khí (xa nhau, bay nhanh)
cards.definition: Solids have fixed shapes. Liquids take container shape. Gases compress easily.
cards.example: Gas particles are far apart with empty spaces and can be compressed.

cards.vietnamese: Khí quyển Trái Đất: 80% (4/5) khí Nitơ + 21% (1/5) khí Oxy
cards.definition: Layer of gas around Earth: ~80% Nitrogen, ~21% Oxygen, tiny CO2 and water vapour.
cards.example: We inhale oxygen from the atmosphere for cellular respiration.

cards.vietnamese: Điểm nóng chảy băng đá: 0°C | Điểm sôi của nước nguyên chất: 100°C
cards.definition: Melting: Solid -> Liquid (0°C). Boiling: Liquid -> Gas / Steam (100°C).
cards.example: When water boils at 100°C, it forms bubbles of steam (water vapour).

cards.vietnamese: Hiện tượng đặc biệt: Khi đóng băng, nước NỞ RA (expands) và trở nên nhẹ hơn
cards.definition: Most substances contract when cooled, but liquid water expands when freezing into ice.
cards.example: A glass bottle filled with water can crack in the freezer because ice expands.

exercises.question: The phase change from a solid to a liquid is called ________.
exercises.explanation: Sự chuyển từ chất rắn sang chất lỏng gọi là melting (nóng chảy).

exercises.question: When pure liquid water boils vigorously, it forms bubbles of a gas called ________.
exercises.explanation: Khi nước sôi ở 100°C, các bọt khí tạo ra là hơi nước (steam / water vapour).

exercises.question: What is the boiling point of pure water at normal atmospheric pressure?
exercises.explanation: Điểm sôi của nước nguyên chất là 100°C.

exercises.question: What is the melting point of ice (and freezing point of water)?
exercises.explanation: Băng đá nóng chảy ở 0°C và nước đóng băng ở 0°C.

exercises.question: Which gas makes up approximately 80% (4/5) of Earth's atmosphere?
exercises.explanation: Khí Nitơ chiếm khoảng 78–80% bầu khí quyển Trái Đất.

exercises.question: What gas makes up approximately 21% (1/5) of the atmosphere, essential for animals to breathe?
exercises.explanation: Khí Oxy chiếm khoảng 21% khí quyển, cần thiết cho hô hấp.

exercises.question: What happens to the volume of water when it freezes into solid ice?
exercises.explanation: Hiện tượng dị thường của nước: khi đóng băng, các phân tử sắp xếp tạo khoang rỗng làm thể tích nở ra (expands).

exercises.question: What unit is used to measure sound volume (loudness)?
exercises.explanation: Âm lượng âm thanh được đo bằng đơn vị Decibel (dB).

exercises.question: Prolonged exposure to sounds above what level can cause permanent hearing damage?
exercises.explanation: Âm thanh trên 85 dB có nguy cơ gây tổn thương vĩnh viễn màng nhĩ và thính giác.

exercises.question: According to the Golden Pitch Rule, tightening a guitar string makes it vibrate ________, producing a ________ pitch.
exercises.explanation: Dây đàn càng căng (tighter) thì rung càng nhanh (faster), tạo ra âm càng cao/bổng (higher pitch).

exercises.question: Which materials are best suited to muffle (deaden) sound vibrations effectively?
options: Soft, porous materials like wool and foam
exercises.explanation: Vật liệu mềm, xốp (soft and porous) như len, mút xốp hấp thụ rung động âm thanh tốt nhất.

exercises.question: In an electronic sound system, which device catches sound waves and converts them into electrical signals?
exercises.explanation: Microphone là thiết bị thu nhận sóng âm thanh.

exercises.question: Which state of matter has particles that are very far apart and can be EASILY compressed?
exercises.explanation: Các hạt chất khí (gas) nằm rất xa nhau, chuyển động tự do hỗn loạn nên dễ dàng bị nén lại.

exercises.question: When blowing across two glass bottles, Bottle A has 80% water and Bottle B has 20% water. Which bottle produces a HIGHER pitch?
exercises.explanation: Khi thổi hơi vào miệng chai, cột không khí dao động. Chai A nhiều nước -> cột không khí ngắn hơn -> rung nhanh hơn -> cao độ cao hơn.

exercises.question: Which instrument uses a column of vibrating air to produce sound?
exercises.explanation: Flute (sáo) là nhạc cụ bộ hơi (wind instrument), tạo âm thanh từ dao động của luồng không khí.
